split_policy.dated_selection: last 12 common valid Mondays; earlier 6 validation, later 6 final test
split_policy.solar_selection: last 12 valid original row indices; generic, not chronological
split_policy.remaining: ALL other valid base weeks go to train, separately by source
split_policy.chronology_note: Some non-common training weeks can be later than holdout dates.
split_policy.final_test_policy: Never use for Optuna, coefficient selection, pruning, or checkpoint selection.
split_policy.training_scenarios: independent draws from each source's train-only base weeks

forecast_policy: synthetic noisy forecasts; extension repeats the SAME chosen base realization
